title: Encode and read pairing offers
responsibility: Write the exact QR offer format and validate scanned offers against environment and expiry rules.

inputs.name: offerEnvironment.origin
inputs.description: Exact relay origin with no path; supported forms are named HTTPS origins or HTTP loopback origins.

inputs.name: pairingOffer.offer
inputs.description: Relay origin, host and pairing IDs, human pairing code and expiry time to serialize.

inputs.name: readPairingOffer.text
inputs.description: Scanned offer text in the fixed protocol field order.

inputs.name: readPairingOffer.reading
inputs.description: Current time in milliseconds and allowed local or production environments.

outputs.name: offerRules
outputs.description: Protocol version 1, harness-phone audience, 320-character limit and 60-second clock-skew allowance.

outputs.name: offerEnvironment
outputs.description: Production for a permitted named HTTPS origin, local for permitted HTTP loopback, otherwise null.

outputs.name: pairingOffer
outputs.description: Canonical offer text with normalized code and expiry rounded down to whole seconds.

outputs.name: readPairingOffer
outputs.description: Parsed offer or invalid, unsupported, environment or expired refusal; accepted expiry must be within the pairing TTL plus clock allowance.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The writer throws Invalid pairing offer for an unsupported origin or malformed or oversized serialized fields.
